name: Balance Amounts 5
definition: Posting of an item to a cash account, in the context of a cash transaction, that results in an increase or decrease to the balance of the account.

HoldingValue.name: Holding Value
HoldingValue.definition: Value of an individual financial instrument holding within a safekeeping account.

PreviousHoldingValue.name: Previous Holding Value
PreviousHoldingValue.definition: Previous value of an individual financial instrument holding within a safekeeping account.

BookValue.name: Book Value
BookValue.definition: Value of a financial instrument, as booked/acquired in an account. It may be used to establish capital gain tax liability.

UnrealisedGainLoss.name: Unrealised Gain Loss
UnrealisedGainLoss.definition: Difference between holding value and the book value.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.
